concepts.title: AWS global infrastructure: Regions, AZs, edge locations
concepts.titleEs: Infraestructura global de AWS: Regions, AZs y edge locations
concepts.summary: Choose Region/AZ placement for latency, data residency, availability and cost, knowing AZs are isolated failure domains within a Region.

concepts.title: Shared responsibility model
concepts.titleEs: Modelo de responsabilidad compartida
concepts.summary: Decide whether a security control (patching, encryption, physical security) is the customer's or AWS's responsibility for IaaS vs managed services.

concepts.title: AWS Well-Architected Framework pillars
concepts.titleEs: Pilares del AWS Well-Architected Framework
concepts.summary: Map a scenario requirement to the pillar (security, reliability, performance, cost, operational excellence, sustainability) it is testing.

concepts.title: Storage types: object vs file vs block
concepts.titleEs: Tipos de almacenamiento: object vs file vs block
concepts.summary: Classify a workload's access pattern (object API, shared POSIX/SMB file system, single-instance block device) to pick the right storage family.

concepts.title: Managed and purpose-built services vs self-managed
concepts.titleEs: Servicios administrados y purpose-built vs autogestionados
concepts.summary: Prefer a managed or purpose-built service over self-managed software on EC2 when the scenario prioritizes reduced operational burden.

concepts.title: Exam cue: "least operational overhead"
concepts.titleEs: Pista de examen: "least operational overhead"
concepts.summary: When a question says least operational overhead / least management effort, pick serverless or fully managed options and eliminate custom scripts and EC2-hosted software.

concepts.title: Exam cue: "most cost-effective"
concepts.titleEs: Pista de examen: "most cost-effective"
concepts.summary: When a question says most cost-effective / lowest cost, choose the cheapest option that still meets every stated requirement (durability, availability, retrieval time).

concepts.title: Exam cue: "highly available" vs "fault tolerant"
concepts.titleEs: Pista de examen: "highly available" vs "fault tolerant"
concepts.summary: Translate availability wording into Multi-AZ (HA) or multi-Region/redundant-capacity (fault tolerance, DR) designs and discard single-AZ answers.

concepts.title: Exam cue: "most secure" and least privilege
concepts.titleEs: Pista de examen: "most secure" y least privilege
concepts.summary: When asked for the most secure option, prefer roles over access keys, private connectivity over internet paths, and the narrowest permissions that work.

concepts.title: Exam cue: performance, latency and throughput wording
concepts.titleEs: Pista de examen: performance, latencia y throughput
concepts.summary: Recognize cues like "sub-millisecond", "global users", "millions of requests per second" and map them to caching, edge, or purpose-built data stores.

concepts.title: Horizontal vs vertical scaling
concepts.titleEs: Escalado horizontal vs vertical
concepts.summary: Decide between adding instances (scale out, needs statelessness) and resizing an instance (scale up, downtime and ceiling limits).

concepts.title: Root user protection and MFA
concepts.titleEs: Protección del root user y MFA
concepts.summary: Apply root user hardening (MFA, no access keys, use only for root-only tasks) and enforce MFA for IAM users.

concepts.title: IAM users, groups and roles
concepts.titleEs: IAM users, groups y roles
concepts.summary: Pick users, groups or roles for a principal, favouring roles with temporary credentials over long-term access keys.

concepts.title: IAM identity-based policies and least privilege
concepts.titleEs: Identity-based policies y least privilege
concepts.summary: Write or pick the policy that grants only the required actions/resources to users, groups or roles.

concepts.title: IAM policy evaluation logic (explicit deny wins)
concepts.titleEs: Lógica de evaluación de políticas IAM (explicit deny gana)
concepts.summary: Predict whether a request is allowed when identity, resource, SCP and boundary policies combine, knowing explicit deny overrides any allow.

concepts.title: IAM policy conditions (SourceIp, PrincipalOrgID, MFA, tags)
concepts.titleEs: Conditions en políticas IAM (SourceIp, PrincipalOrgID, MFA, tags)
concepts.summary: Use condition keys (aws:PrincipalOrgID, aws:SourceVpce, aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent, aws:RequestedRegion) to restrict access without redesigning the architecture.

concepts.title: Resource-based policies (S3, KMS, SQS, Lambda)
concepts.titleEs: Resource-based policies (S3, KMS, SQS, Lambda)
concepts.summary: Determine when a resource policy is needed (cross-account access, service principals invoking resources) versus an identity policy.

concepts.title: IAM roles for EC2 (instance profiles), Lambda and ECS tasks
concepts.titleEs: IAM roles para EC2 (instance profiles), Lambda y ECS tasks
concepts.summary: Give applications on EC2/Lambda/ECS AWS permissions via attached roles instead of storing access keys in code or config.

concepts.title: AWS STS AssumeRole, role switching and cross-account access
concepts.titleEs: AWS STS AssumeRole, role switching y acceso cross-account
concepts.summary: Design cross-account access with a trusted role (trust policy + permissions policy, optional external ID) instead of sharing users.

concepts.title: AWS Organizations, OUs and consolidated billing
concepts.titleEs: AWS Organizations, OUs y consolidated billing
concepts.summary: Structure multiple accounts into OUs for isolation, central governance and consolidated billing with shared volume discounts.

concepts.title: Service control policies (SCPs)
concepts.titleEs: Service control policies (SCPs)
concepts.summary: Use SCPs as guardrails that cap maximum permissions for accounts/OUs (e.g., deny Regions or deny disabling CloudTrail), knowing they grant nothing.

concepts.title: IAM permissions boundaries
concepts.titleEs: IAM permissions boundaries
concepts.summary: Use a permissions boundary to let developers create roles/users without escalating beyond a defined maximum.

concepts.title: AWS Control Tower landing zone and controls
concepts.titleEs: AWS Control Tower: landing zone y controls
concepts.summary: Choose Control Tower to set up and govern a secure multi-account environment with preventive and detective guardrails with minimal effort.

concepts.title: AWS IAM Identity Center (workforce SSO)
concepts.titleEs: AWS IAM Identity Center (SSO para empleados)
concepts.summary: Pick IAM Identity Center for centralized workforce SSO and permission sets across many accounts, optionally sourced from an external IdP or AD.

concepts.title: Identity federation with SAML 2.0 and OIDC
concepts.titleEs: Federación de identidades con SAML 2.0 y OIDC
concepts.summary: Decide when to federate an existing corporate IdP to IAM roles instead of creating IAM users.

concepts.title: AWS Directory Service: Managed Microsoft AD vs AD Connector vs Simple AD
concepts.titleEs: AWS Directory Service: Managed Microsoft AD vs AD Connector vs Simple AD
concepts.summary: Pick AD Connector to proxy to on-prem AD, Managed Microsoft AD for a full AD in AWS (trusts, FSx for Windows), or Simple AD for basic low-cost needs.

concepts.title: Amazon Cognito user pools (app sign-up/sign-in)
concepts.titleEs: Amazon Cognito user pools (registro/login de apps)
concepts.summary: Use Cognito user pools for customer-facing app authentication (sign-up, social/SAML login, JWTs) including API Gateway/ALB authorization.

concepts.title: Amazon Cognito identity pools (temporary AWS credentials)
concepts.titleEs: Amazon Cognito identity pools (credenciales AWS temporales)
concepts.summary: Use identity pools to give mobile/web users (authenticated or guest) scoped temporary AWS credentials to call services like S3 directly.

concepts.title: AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) and VPC sharing
concepts.titleEs: AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) y VPC sharing
concepts.summary: Share subnets, Transit Gateways, or other resources across accounts in an organization instead of duplicating them.

concepts.title: VPC CIDR planning, subnets and IP addressing
concepts.titleEs: Planificación de CIDR de VPC, subnets y direccionamiento IP
concepts.summary: Size non-overlapping CIDRs and per-AZ subnets so the network can grow and later peer or connect to on-premises.

concepts.title: Route tables and internet gateways
concepts.titleEs: Route tables e internet gateways
concepts.summary: Explain what makes a subnet public (route to an IGW) and troubleshoot connectivity by reading route tables.

concepts.title: Public vs private subnet segmentation
concepts.titleEs: Segmentación con subnets públicas vs privadas
concepts.summary: Place load balancers in public subnets and app/DB tiers in private subnets to minimize exposure.

concepts.title: NAT gateway vs NAT instance
concepts.titleEs: NAT gateway vs NAT instance
concepts.summary: Give private subnets outbound-only internet access with a managed, AZ-scoped NAT gateway rather than a self-managed NAT instance.

concepts.title: NAT gateway per AZ vs single shared NAT gateway
concepts.titleEs: NAT gateway por AZ vs un NAT gateway compartido
concepts.summary: Trade off one NAT gateway per AZ (resilient, no cross-AZ charges) against a single shared NAT gateway (cheaper, single point of failure) for prod vs non-prod.

concepts.title: Security groups (stateful instance firewall)
concepts.titleEs: Security groups (firewall stateful a nivel de instancia)
concepts.summary: Write allow-only, stateful rules including SG-to-SG references (e.g., DB SG only allows the app SG on 3306).

concepts.title: Network ACLs (stateless subnet firewall)
concepts.titleEs: Network ACLs (firewall stateless a nivel de subnet)
concepts.summary: Use NACLs for subnet-level allow/deny with ordered rules, remembering ephemeral return ports and that denying a specific IP needs a NACL, not an SG.

concepts.title: Bastion hosts vs Systems Manager Session Manager
concepts.titleEs: Bastion hosts vs Systems Manager Session Manager
concepts.summary: Replace SSH bastions and open port 22 with Session Manager for audited, keyless shell access to private instances.

concepts.title: VPC endpoints: gateway (S3/DynamoDB) vs interface
concepts.titleEs: VPC endpoints: gateway (S3/DynamoDB) vs interface
concepts.summary: Reach AWS services privately: free gateway endpoints for S3/DynamoDB via route tables, interface endpoints (ENIs, hourly cost) for most other services.

concepts.title: VPC endpoint policies and aws:SourceVpce bucket policies
concepts.titleEs: Endpoint policies y bucket policies con aws:SourceVpce
concepts.summary: Restrict which buckets can be reached through an endpoint and make a bucket accessible only from a specific VPC endpoint.

concepts.title: AWS PrivateLink endpoint services (share a service privately)
concepts.titleEs: AWS PrivateLink endpoint services (exponer un servicio en privado)
concepts.summary: Expose a service behind an NLB to many consumer VPCs/accounts privately, even with overlapping CIDRs, without peering.

concepts.title: VPC peering
concepts.titleEs: VPC peering
concepts.summary: Connect a few VPCs privately (no transitive routing, no overlapping CIDRs) at the lowest cost.

concepts.title: AWS Transit Gateway hub-and-spoke
concepts.titleEs: AWS Transit Gateway (hub-and-spoke)
concepts.summary: Replace a mesh of peering connections with a transitive hub for many VPCs and on-premises networks, including route-table segmentation.

concepts.title: AWS Site-to-Site VPN
concepts.titleEs: AWS Site-to-Site VPN
concepts.summary: Pick an IPsec VPN over the internet for quick, encrypted, low-cost hybrid connectivity (two tunnels, ~1.25 Gbps per tunnel).

concepts.title: AWS Direct Connect
concepts.titleEs: AWS Direct Connect
concepts.summary: Choose a dedicated private line for consistent bandwidth/latency and lower data-transfer-out cost, accepting weeks of provisioning lead time.

concepts.title: Direct Connect resiliency, VPN backup and encryption (MACsec/VPN over DX)
concepts.titleEs: Resiliencia de Direct Connect, VPN de respaldo y cifrado (MACsec/VPN sobre DX)
concepts.summary: Design for DX failure with a second DX location or a backup VPN, and add encryption (IPsec VPN over DX or MACsec) when required.

concepts.title: AWS Client VPN (remote users)
concepts.titleEs: AWS Client VPN (usuarios remotos)
concepts.summary: Give individual remote employees managed OpenVPN-based access to VPC and on-prem resources.

concepts.title: Bandwidth allocation: multiple VPNs, ECMP, DX speeds
concepts.titleEs: Asignación de ancho de banda: múltiples VPNs, ECMP y velocidades de DX
concepts.summary: Size hybrid bandwidth by combining VPN tunnels with ECMP on Transit Gateway or selecting the right DX dedicated/hosted port speed.

concepts.title: Route 53 Resolver inbound/outbound endpoints for hybrid DNS
concepts.titleEs: Route 53 Resolver endpoints inbound/outbound para DNS híbrido
concepts.summary: Resolve on-prem names from VPCs (outbound endpoint + forwarding rules) and VPC private zones from on-prem (inbound endpoint).

concepts.title: AWS Network Firewall
concepts.titleEs: AWS Network Firewall
concepts.summary: Add stateful inspection, IPS and domain filtering for VPC traffic (including centralized egress) beyond what SGs/NACLs offer.

concepts.title: VPC Flow Logs
concepts.titleEs: VPC Flow Logs
concepts.summary: Capture accepted/rejected IP traffic metadata to troubleshoot SG/NACL issues or detect anomalies (not packet contents).

concepts.title: Multi-tier VPC architecture across AZs
concepts.titleEs: Arquitectura multinivel en VPC a través de AZs
concepts.summary: Lay out web/app/data tiers in subnet tiers across at least two AZs with SG chaining and correct routing.

concepts.title: EC2 instance families and types
concepts.titleEs: Familias y tipos de instancias EC2
concepts.summary: Select general purpose, compute, memory, storage or accelerated families (and Graviton) from workload characteristics.

concepts.title: Right-sizing with AWS Compute Optimizer
concepts.titleEs: Right-sizing con AWS Compute Optimizer
concepts.summary: Use utilization data and Compute Optimizer recommendations to pick a smaller/cheaper instance, EBS volume or Lambda memory size.

concepts.title: AMIs, user data and golden images
concepts.titleEs: AMIs, user data y golden images
concepts.summary: Speed up and standardize instance launches with pre-baked AMIs versus bootstrapping with user data; copy AMIs across Regions for DR.

concepts.title: Instance metadata service (IMDSv2)
concepts.titleEs: Instance metadata service (IMDSv2)
concepts.summary: Know how instances get role credentials via IMDS and require IMDSv2 to mitigate SSRF credential theft.

concepts.title: EC2 placement groups: cluster, spread, partition
concepts.titleEs: Placement groups de EC2: cluster, spread, partition
concepts.summary: Pick cluster for low-latency HPC, spread for isolating a few critical instances, partition for large distributed systems like HDFS/Cassandra.

concepts.title: EC2 hibernate vs stop
concepts.titleEs: EC2 hibernate vs stop
concepts.summary: Use hibernation to preserve in-memory state and speed restarts of long-initializing instances while not paying for compute.

concepts.title: EC2 purchase options overview
concepts.titleEs: Opciones de compra de EC2 (visión general)
concepts.summary: Map workload predictability and interruption tolerance to On-Demand, Savings Plans/RIs, Spot, Dedicated or Capacity Reservations.

concepts.title: Reserved Instances (standard vs convertible, zonal vs regional)
concepts.titleEs: Reserved Instances (standard vs convertible, zonal vs regional)
concepts.summary: Commit 1 or 3 years for steady-state workloads; choose convertible for flexibility, zonal for a capacity reservation.

concepts.title: Savings Plans (Compute vs EC2 Instance)
concepts.titleEs: Savings Plans (Compute vs EC2 Instance)
concepts.summary: Choose Compute Savings Plans to discount steady usage across EC2 families, Regions, Fargate and Lambda; EC2 Instance SP for deeper discount in one family/Region.

concepts.title: Spot Instances, interruptions and Spot Fleet
concepts.titleEs: Spot Instances, interrupciones y Spot Fleet
concepts.summary: Use Spot (up to 90% off) only for fault-tolerant, stateless or checkpointed jobs; diversify instance types and handle 2-minute interruption notices.

concepts.title: Dedicated Hosts vs Dedicated Instances (licensing, compliance)
concepts.titleEs: Dedicated Hosts vs Dedicated Instances (licencias, compliance)
concepts.summary: Pick Dedicated Hosts for BYOL socket/core-bound licenses and host visibility; Dedicated Instances for hardware isolation only.

concepts.title: On-Demand Capacity Reservations
concepts.titleEs: On-Demand Capacity Reservations
concepts.summary: Guarantee capacity in a specific AZ (e.g., for DR or events) without a term commitment, combining with Savings Plans for discount.

concepts.title: EC2 Auto Scaling groups and launch templates
concepts.titleEs: EC2 Auto Scaling groups y launch templates
concepts.summary: Use an ASG spanning multiple AZs with min/desired/max capacity to self-heal and scale a fleet behind a load balancer.

concepts.title: Scaling policies: target tracking, step, scheduled, predictive
concepts.titleEs: Scaling policies: target tracking, step, scheduled, predictive
concepts.summary: Choose target tracking for steady metrics, scheduled for known peaks, predictive for recurring patterns, step for tiered responses.

concepts.title: ASG health checks, warm pools and lifecycle hooks
concepts.titleEs: Health checks de ASG, warm pools y lifecycle hooks
concepts.summary: Enable ELB health checks so unhealthy instances are replaced, and use lifecycle hooks/warm pools for graceful startup/shutdown tasks.

concepts.title: AWS Auto Scaling and Application Auto Scaling (DynamoDB, ECS, Aurora)
concepts.titleEs: AWS Auto Scaling y Application Auto Scaling (DynamoDB, ECS, Aurora)
concepts.summary: Scale non-EC2 resources (ECS services, DynamoDB capacity, Aurora replicas, Spot Fleet) with target tracking.

concepts.title: Choosing scaling metrics and conditions
concepts.titleEs: Elegir métricas y condiciones de escalado
concepts.summary: Pick the metric that reflects load (CPU, ALB RequestCountPerTarget, SQS backlog per instance) rather than one that lags or misleads.

concepts.title: Stateless vs stateful workloads and session state
concepts.titleEs: Workloads stateless vs stateful y estado de sesión
concepts.summary: Externalize session state to ElastiCache/DynamoDB so instances can scale out and fail without losing sessions; know sticky sessions are a workaround.

concepts.title: AWS Lambda fundamentals and limits
concepts.titleEs: Fundamentos y límites de AWS Lambda
concepts.summary: Use Lambda for event-driven code under 15 minutes, knowing memory (128 MB-10 GB) also scales CPU, and when limits push you to containers.

concepts.title: Lambda memory/timeout sizing and performance
concepts.titleEs: Tamaño de memoria/timeout de Lambda y rendimiento
concepts.summary: Raise Lambda memory to get proportionally more CPU for faster (sometimes cheaper) execution; set timeouts appropriately.

concepts.title: Lambda concurrency: reserved vs provisioned, cold starts
concepts.titleEs: Concurrencia de Lambda: reserved vs provisioned, cold starts
concepts.summary: Use provisioned concurrency to remove cold-start latency and reserved concurrency to guarantee/cap capacity and protect downstream systems.

concepts.title: Lambda in a VPC (private resources, NAT for internet)
concepts.titleEs: Lambda en una VPC (recursos privados, NAT para internet)
concepts.summary: Attach Lambda to private subnets to reach RDS/ElastiCache; add a NAT gateway or VPC endpoints for internet/AWS API access.

concepts.title: When to use containers and migrating apps into containers
concepts.titleEs: Cuándo usar containers y migrar aplicaciones a containers
concepts.summary: Decide when containers beat VMs or Lambda (portability, long-running, dense packing), store images in ECR, and containerize a legacy app with minimal code change.

concepts.title: Amazon ECS: EC2 vs Fargate launch types
concepts.titleEs: Amazon ECS: launch types EC2 vs Fargate
concepts.summary: Run containers on ECS with Fargate for no server management, or the EC2 launch type for GPU, custom AMIs, or Reserved/Spot capacity control.

concepts.title: AWS Fargate serverless containers
concepts.titleEs: AWS Fargate (containers serverless)
concepts.summary: Pick Fargate when containers must run without managing EC2 hosts (least operational overhead), including Fargate Spot for interruptible tasks.

concepts.title: Amazon EKS (managed Kubernetes)
concepts.titleEs: Amazon EKS (Kubernetes administrado)
concepts.summary: Choose EKS when the team already uses Kubernetes or needs K8s portability; ECS when simpler AWS-native orchestration is enough.

concepts.title: AWS Elastic Beanstalk
concepts.titleEs: AWS Elastic Beanstalk
concepts.summary: Deploy a standard web app quickly with managed provisioning of ELB/ASG/monitoring while keeping access to underlying resources.

concepts.title: AWS Batch
concepts.titleEs: AWS Batch
concepts.summary: Run large-scale batch/HPC jobs with managed queues and compute environments (often Spot) instead of building a scheduler.

concepts.title: Cost-effective compute choice: Lambda vs Fargate vs EC2
concepts.titleEs: Elegir cómputo costo-efectivo: Lambda vs Fargate vs EC2
concepts.summary: Match utilization to billing model: spiky/low-volume -> Lambda, steady containers -> Fargate/ECS with SP, high steady load -> EC2 with RI/SP/Spot.

concepts.title: Availability classes: production vs non-production schedules
concepts.titleEs: Clases de disponibilidad: producción vs no producción
concepts.summary: Lower cost of dev/test by stopping instances off-hours, using single-AZ and smaller sizes, while keeping Multi-AZ for production.

concepts.title: AWS Outposts (AWS on premises)
concepts.titleEs: AWS Outposts (AWS on-premises)
concepts.summary: Pick Outposts when workloads must run on premises for low latency or data residency with the same AWS APIs.

concepts.title: Local Zones and Wavelength (edge compute)
concepts.titleEs: Local Zones y Wavelength (cómputo en el edge)
concepts.summary: Use Local Zones for single-digit-ms latency to a metro area and Wavelength for ultra-low latency to 5G mobile devices.

concepts.title: VMware Cloud on AWS
concepts.titleEs: VMware Cloud on AWS
concepts.summary: Migrate or extend vSphere workloads to AWS without refactoring when the team must keep VMware tooling.

concepts.title: ECS Anywhere and EKS Anywhere
concepts.titleEs: ECS Anywhere y EKS Anywhere
concepts.summary: Run and manage containers on customer-owned hardware with the same ECS/EKS control plane tooling.

concepts.title: Elastic Load Balancing: ALB vs NLB vs GWLB
concepts.titleEs: Elastic Load Balancing: ALB vs NLB vs GWLB
concepts.summary: Select the load balancer type by OSI layer, protocol and feature needs, and know cross-zone balancing, deregistration delay and sticky sessions.

concepts.title: Application Load Balancer: path/host routing, targets, auth
concepts.titleEs: Application Load Balancer: path/host routing, targets, auth
concepts.summary: Use ALB for HTTP/HTTPS (Layer 7) with path/host/header routing, Lambda/IP/container targets, WAF and Cognito/OIDC authentication.

concepts.title: Network Load Balancer: TCP/UDP, static IPs, extreme performance
concepts.titleEs: Network Load Balancer: TCP/UDP, IPs estáticas, alto rendimiento
concepts.summary: Use NLB for Layer 4 TCP/UDP/TLS, millions of requests per second, ultra-low latency, static/Elastic IPs per AZ, or PrivateLink services.

concepts.title: Gateway Load Balancer for third-party appliances
concepts.titleEs: Gateway Load Balancer para appliances de terceros
concepts.summary: Insert and scale inline virtual firewalls/IDS/IPS (GENEVE) transparently for all traffic.

concepts.title: TLS termination on load balancers with ACM and SNI
concepts.titleEs: Terminación TLS en load balancers con ACM y SNI
concepts.summary: Offload TLS to ALB/NLB with free auto-renewing ACM certificates and SNI for multiple domains; re-encrypt to targets when end-to-end encryption is required.

concepts.title: Route 53 hosted zones, record types and alias records
concepts.titleEs: Route 53 hosted zones, tipos de registro y alias records
concepts.summary: Use alias records (free, zone apex) to point to ELB/CloudFront/S3, and private hosted zones for internal DNS.

concepts.title: Route 53 health checks
concepts.titleEs: Route 53 health checks
concepts.summary: Monitor endpoints, calculated checks or CloudWatch alarms so DNS stops answering with unhealthy resources.

concepts.title: Route 53 failover routing (active-passive)
concepts.titleEs: Route 53 failover routing (activo-pasivo)
concepts.summary: Route to a secondary site/static S3 page only when the primary health check fails.

concepts.title: Route 53 latency-based routing
concepts.titleEs: Route 53 latency-based routing
concepts.summary: Send users to the Region with lowest network latency for a multi-Region active-active app.

concepts.title: Route 53 geolocation vs geoproximity routing
concepts.titleEs: Route 53 geolocation vs geoproximity routing
concepts.summary: Use geolocation to serve by user country/continent (compliance, localization) and geoproximity with bias to shift traffic between locations.

concepts.title: Route 53 weighted routing
concepts.titleEs: Route 53 weighted routing
concepts.summary: Split traffic by percentage for canary/blue-green releases or gradual migrations.

concepts.title: Amazon CloudFront: distributions, origins, caching and TTLs
concepts.titleEs: Amazon CloudFront: distributions, origins, caching y TTLs
concepts.summary: Put CloudFront in front of S3/ALB/custom origins to cache static and dynamic content at the edge, reduce latency and offload origins.

concepts.title: CloudFront origin access control (OAC) for private S3 origins
concepts.titleEs: CloudFront origin access control (OAC) para origins S3 privados
concepts.summary: Keep the bucket private and allow reads only from the CloudFront distribution via OAC and a bucket policy.

concepts.title: CloudFront signed URLs vs signed cookies
concepts.titleEs: CloudFront signed URLs vs signed cookies
concepts.summary: Restrict premium content: signed URL for a single file, signed cookies for many files without changing URLs.

concepts.title: CloudFront geo restriction, HTTPS and field-level encryption
concepts.titleEs: CloudFront geo restriction, HTTPS y field-level encryption
concepts.summary: Block countries at the edge, enforce HTTPS viewer/origin policies (ACM cert in us-east-1), and protect sensitive form fields.

concepts.title: CloudFront origin groups and failover
concepts.titleEs: CloudFront origin groups y failover
concepts.summary: Configure a secondary origin (e.g., replica bucket in another Region) that CloudFront uses when the primary returns errors.

concepts.title: CloudFront Functions vs Lambda@Edge
concepts.titleEs: CloudFront Functions vs Lambda@Edge
concepts.summary: Run lightweight header/URL manipulation in CloudFront Functions and heavier logic (network calls, body access) in Lambda@Edge.

concepts.title: AWS Global Accelerator
concepts.titleEs: AWS Global Accelerator
concepts.summary: Use two static anycast IPs and the AWS backbone for non-HTTP (TCP/UDP) or IP-allow-listed apps needing fast regional failover.

concepts.title: S3 Transfer Acceleration
concepts.titleEs: S3 Transfer Acceleration
concepts.summary: Speed long-distance uploads to a single bucket from globally distributed users via edge locations.

concepts.title: Amazon S3 fundamentals: durability, consistency, object limits
concepts.titleEs: Fundamentos de Amazon S3: durabilidad, consistencia, límites
concepts.summary: Use S3 for virtually unlimited, 11-nines durable object storage with strong read-after-write consistency and objects up to 5 TB.

concepts.title: S3 storage classes overview
concepts.titleEs: Storage classes de S3 (visión general)
concepts.summary: Pick the storage class from access frequency, retrieval time, minimum duration and AZ-resilience needs.

concepts.title: S3 Standard-IA vs One Zone-IA
concepts.titleEs: S3 Standard-IA vs One Zone-IA
concepts.summary: Use Standard-IA for infrequently accessed critical data needing ms access; One Zone-IA for re-creatable data where AZ loss is acceptable.

concepts.title: S3 Intelligent-Tiering
concepts.titleEs: S3 Intelligent-Tiering
concepts.summary: Choose Intelligent-Tiering for unknown or changing access patterns to optimize cost automatically without retrieval fees.

concepts.title: S3 Glacier Instant/Flexible/Deep Archive and retrieval tiers
concepts.titleEs: S3 Glacier Instant/Flexible/Deep Archive y retrieval tiers
concepts.summary: Match archive class and retrieval tier (expedited minutes, standard hours, bulk up to 48 h) to required restore time at lowest cost.

concepts.title: S3 Lifecycle transitions and expiration
concepts.titleEs: S3 Lifecycle: transiciones y expiración
concepts.summary: Automate moving objects to colder classes and expiring old objects/versions/incomplete multipart uploads by age, prefix or tag.

concepts.title: S3 Versioning and MFA Delete
concepts.titleEs: S3 Versioning y MFA Delete
concepts.summary: Protect against accidental overwrite/delete by keeping versions, and require MFA to permanently delete versions.

concepts.title: S3 Object Lock and Glacier Vault Lock (WORM)
concepts.titleEs: S3 Object Lock y Glacier Vault Lock (WORM)
concepts.summary: Meet regulatory WORM retention with Object Lock compliance mode (no one can delete) vs governance mode, retention periods and legal holds.

concepts.title: S3 Cross-Region and Same-Region Replication
concepts.titleEs: S3 Cross-Region y Same-Region Replication
concepts.summary: Replicate new objects (versioning required; Batch Replication for existing) for DR, latency, compliance or aggregation; RTC for 15-minute SLA.

concepts.title: S3 encryption: SSE-S3, SSE-KMS, DSSE-KMS, SSE-C, client-side
concepts.titleEs: Cifrado en S3: SSE-S3, SSE-KMS, DSSE-KMS, SSE-C, client-side
concepts.summary: Choose SSE-KMS for audited, key-policy-controlled encryption, SSE-S3 for simplest default, SSE-C/client-side when the customer must hold keys.

concepts.title: S3 bucket policies, ACLs and Block Public Access
concepts.titleEs: S3 bucket policies, ACLs y Block Public Access
concepts.summary: Control bucket access with policies (disable ACLs via Object Ownership), enforce TLS/encryption with conditions, and block public exposure org-wide.

concepts.title: S3 presigned URLs
concepts.titleEs: S3 presigned URLs
concepts.summary: Grant time-limited upload/download access to a private object without making it public or creating IAM users.

concepts.title: S3 Access Points (and Object Lambda)
concepts.titleEs: S3 Access Points (y Object Lambda)
concepts.summary: Simplify access for many teams/apps to a shared bucket with per-application access points and VPC-restricted network origins.

concepts.title: S3 performance: prefixes, multipart upload, byte-range fetches
concepts.titleEs: Rendimiento de S3: prefijos, multipart upload, byte-range fetches
concepts.summary: Scale throughput with parallel prefixes, multipart uploads (>100 MB) and byte-range GETs; batch small objects instead of many individual uploads.

concepts.title: S3 Event Notifications (Lambda, SQS, SNS, EventBridge)
concepts.titleEs: S3 Event Notifications (Lambda, SQS, SNS, EventBridge)
concepts.summary: Trigger processing (e.g., thumbnails) when objects are created, using EventBridge for advanced filtering and multiple targets.

concepts.title: S3 Requester Pays
concepts.titleEs: S3 Requester Pays
concepts.summary: Shift request and data-transfer costs to the consumers of a shared dataset.

concepts.title: S3 static website hosting
concepts.titleEs: Hosting de sitios estáticos en S3
concepts.summary: Host a static site cheaply on S3 (HTTP only), fronting it with CloudFront for HTTPS, caching and private bucket access.

concepts.title: EBS volume types: gp3, io2, st1, sc1
concepts.titleEs: Tipos de volúmenes EBS: gp3, io2, st1, sc1
concepts.summary: Pick gp3 for general SSD, io2 Block Express for high IOPS/low-latency DBs, st1 for throughput-heavy sequential, sc1 for cold cheapest HDD.

concepts.title: EBS IOPS/throughput sizing, Elastic Volumes and EBS-optimized instances
concepts.titleEs: Dimensionar IOPS/throughput de EBS, Elastic Volumes e instancias EBS-optimized
concepts.summary: Provision IOPS/throughput independently (gp3), modify volumes live, and ensure the instance can sustain the EBS bandwidth.

concepts.title: EBS snapshots, Data Lifecycle Manager and Fast Snapshot Restore
concepts.titleEs: EBS snapshots, Data Lifecycle Manager y Fast Snapshot Restore
concepts.summary: Automate incremental snapshots and cross-Region copies, archive old snapshots cheaply, and use FSR to avoid first-read latency.

concepts.title: EBS encryption with KMS
concepts.titleEs: Cifrado de EBS con KMS
concepts.summary: Encrypt volumes/snapshots (enable encryption by default), and encrypt an existing unencrypted volume via snapshot copy with encryption.

concepts.title: EC2 instance store (ephemeral block storage)
concepts.titleEs: EC2 instance store (almacenamiento de bloques efímero)
concepts.summary: Use instance store for highest-IOPS temporary data (caches, scratch, replicated data) knowing data is lost on stop/termination.

concepts.title: Amazon EFS: shared NFS, performance/throughput modes, storage classes
concepts.titleEs: Amazon EFS: NFS compartido, modos de performance/throughput, storage classes
concepts.summary: Use EFS for elastic, Multi-AZ shared Linux file storage across many instances/containers/Lambda, with IA tiering via lifecycle for cost.

concepts.title: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server
concepts.titleEs: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server
concepts.summary: Pick FSx for Windows for SMB shares, NTFS ACLs, AD integration and DFS for Windows workloads (Multi-AZ option).

concepts.title: Amazon FSx for Lustre
concepts.titleEs: Amazon FSx for Lustre
concepts.summary: Use FSx for Lustre for HPC/ML needing sub-ms, hundreds of GB/s throughput, linked to S3 (scratch vs persistent deployment).

concepts.title: Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP and OpenZFS
concepts.titleEs: Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP y OpenZFS
concepts.summary: Pick ONTAP for multi-protocol (NFS/SMB/iSCSI) lift-and-shift of NetApp workloads; OpenZFS for migrating ZFS/Linux NFS workloads.

concepts.title: When storage auto scaling is required (RDS storage autoscaling, EFS, EBS)
concepts.titleEs: Cuándo se necesita auto scaling de almacenamiento (RDS, EFS, EBS)
concepts.summary: Avoid over-provisioning by using elastic storage (S3/EFS) or RDS storage autoscaling for unpredictable growth.

concepts.title: Storage Gateway: S3 File Gateway
concepts.titleEs: Storage Gateway: S3 File Gateway
concepts.summary: Give on-prem apps NFS/SMB access to files stored as S3 objects with a local cache.

concepts.title: Storage Gateway: Volume Gateway cached vs stored
concepts.titleEs: Storage Gateway: Volume Gateway cached vs stored
concepts.summary: Use cached volumes to keep primary data in AWS with hot data local, stored volumes to keep full data on-prem with async EBS-snapshot backups.

concepts.title: Storage Gateway: Tape Gateway
concepts.titleEs: Storage Gateway: Tape Gateway
concepts.summary: Replace physical tape libraries with a virtual tape library backed by S3/Glacier without changing existing backup software.

concepts.title: AWS DataSync
concepts.titleEs: AWS DataSync
concepts.summary: Automate online migration/sync of NFS/SMB/HDFS/object data to S3/EFS/FSx with scheduling, integrity checks and bandwidth throttling.

concepts.title: AWS Transfer Family (SFTP/FTPS/FTP/AS2)
concepts.titleEs: AWS Transfer Family (SFTP/FTPS/FTP/AS2)
concepts.summary: Provide a managed SFTP/FTPS endpoint into S3/EFS for partners without changing their existing file-transfer clients.

concepts.title: AWS Snow Family (Snowball Edge, Snowcone)
concepts.titleEs: AWS Snow Family (Snowball Edge, Snowcone)
concepts.summary: Ship tens of TB to PB offline when network transfer would take too long or be too costly, or process data at disconnected edge sites.

concepts.title: Choosing the lowest-cost transfer method by size, bandwidth and deadline
concepts.titleEs: Elegir el método de transferencia más barato por tamaño, ancho de banda y plazo
concepts.summary: Estimate transfer time from data volume and available bandwidth to choose between internet/DataSync, Direct Connect, or Snowball.

concepts.title: AWS Backup centralized backup plans
concepts.titleEs: AWS Backup: planes de backup centralizados
concepts.summary: Centralize policy-based backups across services/accounts with cross-Region/cross-account copies and Vault Lock for immutability.

concepts.title: Relational vs non-relational data models
concepts.titleEs: Modelos relacionales vs no relacionales
concepts.summary: Decide between SQL (joins, transactions, fixed schema) and NoSQL (key-value/document, massive scale, flexible schema) from access patterns.

concepts.title: Purpose-built database selection (key-value, document, graph, wide-column, time series, ledger)
concepts.titleEs: Selección de bases de datos purpose-built (key-value, documento, grafo, wide-column, time series)
concepts.summary: Map data model and query pattern keywords (graph, MongoDB-compatible, Cassandra, time series, columnar analytics) to the right managed DB.

concepts.title: Amazon RDS fundamentals and engines
concepts.titleEs: Fundamentos de Amazon RDS y motores
concepts.summary: Use RDS for managed relational engines (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Oracle, SQL Server, Db2) when you need no OS access; RDS Custom when you do.

concepts.title: Choosing a database engine (MySQL vs PostgreSQL vs commercial)
concepts.titleEs: Elegir motor de base de datos (MySQL vs PostgreSQL vs comerciales)
concepts.summary: Pick an engine from compatibility, feature needs (extensions, PostGIS), licensing cost (BYOL vs license-included) and Aurora support.

concepts.title: RDS storage types and Provisioned IOPS
concepts.titleEs: Tipos de almacenamiento de RDS y Provisioned IOPS
concepts.summary: Choose gp3 vs Provisioned IOPS (io2) storage and instance class for I/O-intensive OLTP capacity planning.

concepts.title: RDS Multi-AZ deployments (instance and cluster)
concepts.titleEs: RDS Multi-AZ (instance y cluster)
concepts.summary: Use Multi-AZ synchronous standby for HA with automatic failover (DNS endpoint unchanged); the classic standby does not serve reads.

concepts.title: RDS read replicas (in-Region and cross-Region)
concepts.titleEs: RDS read replicas (en la Region y cross-Region)
concepts.summary: Offload read-heavy/reporting traffic with async replicas (up to 15), promote a cross-Region replica for DR; replicas do not provide automatic failover.

concepts.title: RDS automated backups, snapshots and point-in-time recovery
concepts.titleEs: RDS backups automáticos, snapshots y point-in-time recovery
concepts.summary: Set retention (up to 35 days) for PITR, take manual snapshots for long-term, and copy snapshots cross-Region for DR.

concepts.title: RDS encryption at rest/in transit and IAM database authentication
concepts.titleEs: Cifrado en RDS (reposo/tránsito) y IAM database authentication
concepts.summary: Encrypt at creation (or via encrypted snapshot copy for existing DBs), force SSL, and use IAM auth tokens instead of DB passwords.

concepts.title: Amazon RDS Proxy
concepts.titleEs: Amazon RDS Proxy
concepts.summary: Pool and share DB connections for many Lambda/app connections, reduce failover time, and enforce IAM/Secrets Manager auth.

concepts.title: Amazon Aurora architecture (shared storage, 6 copies across 3 AZs)
concepts.titleEs: Arquitectura de Amazon Aurora (storage compartido, 6 copias en 3 AZs)
concepts.summary: Choose Aurora (MySQL/PostgreSQL-compatible) for higher performance and durability with storage auto-growing to 128 TiB and fast failover.

concepts.title: Aurora Replicas, reader/custom endpoints and replica auto scaling
concepts.titleEs: Aurora Replicas, reader/custom endpoints y auto scaling de réplicas
concepts.summary: Scale reads with up to 15 low-lag Aurora Replicas that are also failover targets, routing analytics to a custom endpoint.

concepts.title: Aurora Serverless v2
concepts.titleEs: Aurora Serverless v2
concepts.summary: Use Aurora Serverless v2 for variable/unpredictable or intermittent workloads that need automatic capacity scaling in ACUs.

concepts.title: Aurora Global Database
concepts.titleEs: Aurora Global Database
concepts.summary: Provide sub-second cross-Region replication, local low-latency reads and Region failover (RPO ~1 s, RTO ~1 min) for global relational apps.

concepts.title: Aurora cloning and Backtrack
concepts.titleEs: Aurora cloning y Backtrack
concepts.summary: Create fast copy-on-write test copies of production cheaply, and rewind an Aurora MySQL DB in place after a bad change.

concepts.title: Amazon DynamoDB fundamentals: keys, items, access patterns
concepts.titleEs: Fundamentos de Amazon DynamoDB: claves, items, patrones de acceso
concepts.summary: Use DynamoDB for serverless key-value/document data needing single-digit-ms latency at any scale, designing partition keys for even access.

concepts.title: DynamoDB on-demand vs provisioned capacity (RCU/WCU)
concepts.titleEs: DynamoDB on-demand vs provisioned capacity (RCU/WCU)
concepts.summary: Pick on-demand for unpredictable/spiky traffic, provisioned with auto scaling (and reserved capacity) for steady predictable traffic.

concepts.title: DynamoDB GSIs vs LSIs
concepts.titleEs: DynamoDB GSIs vs LSIs
concepts.summary: Add a GSI (any time, different partition key) or LSI (at creation, same partition key) to support additional query patterns.

concepts.title: DynamoDB Streams and event-driven processing
concepts.titleEs: DynamoDB Streams y procesamiento orientado a eventos
concepts.summary: React to item changes (audit, replication, notifications) with Lambda triggers on a 24-hour ordered change log.

concepts.title: DynamoDB global tables
concepts.titleEs: DynamoDB global tables
concepts.summary: Deliver multi-Region, multi-active, low-latency reads/writes for globally distributed users and Region-level resilience.

concepts.title: DynamoDB on-demand backups and point-in-time recovery
concepts.titleEs: DynamoDB backups on-demand y point-in-time recovery
concepts.summary: Protect tables against accidental writes/deletes with PITR (35 days) and on-demand backups, including export to S3.

concepts.title: DynamoDB Time to Live (TTL)
concepts.titleEs: DynamoDB Time to Live (TTL)
concepts.summary: Automatically delete expired items (sessions, temporary data) at no write cost to enforce retention and cut storage.

concepts.title: Caching strategies: lazy loading, write-through, TTL
concepts.titleEs: Estrategias de caché: lazy loading, write-through, TTL
concepts.summary: Choose where and how to cache (edge, app, DB) and the population/invalidation pattern to cut read latency and DB cost.

concepts.title: ElastiCache for Redis OSS/Valkey
concepts.titleEs: ElastiCache for Redis OSS/Valkey
concepts.summary: Pick Redis/Valkey for caching or session store with replication, Multi-AZ failover, persistence, pub/sub and sorted sets (leaderboards).

concepts.title: ElastiCache for Memcached
concepts.titleEs: ElastiCache for Memcached
concepts.summary: Pick Memcached for a simple, multithreaded, horizontally partitioned cache with no persistence or replication needs.

concepts.title: DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)
concepts.titleEs: DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)
concepts.summary: Add microsecond read caching to DynamoDB with API compatibility and minimal code changes for read-heavy workloads.

concepts.title: Amazon DocumentDB (MongoDB compatible)
concepts.titleEs: Amazon DocumentDB (compatible con MongoDB)
concepts.summary: Migrate MongoDB workloads to a managed JSON document database.

concepts.title: Amazon Keyspaces (Apache Cassandra compatible)
concepts.titleEs: Amazon Keyspaces (compatible con Apache Cassandra)
concepts.summary: Move Cassandra (CQL) workloads to a serverless managed wide-column store.

concepts.title: Amazon Neptune (graph database)
concepts.titleEs: Amazon Neptune (base de datos de grafos)
concepts.summary: Pick Neptune for highly connected data (social networks, fraud detection, knowledge graphs) queried with Gremlin/openCypher/SPARQL.

concepts.title: AWS DMS and Schema Conversion (homogeneous vs heterogeneous migrations)
concepts.titleEs: AWS DMS y Schema Conversion (migraciones homogéneas vs heterogéneas)
concepts.summary: Migrate databases with minimal downtime using DMS (full load + CDC), adding schema conversion only for heterogeneous engine changes.

concepts.title: Database cost optimization (reserved DB instances, serverless, retention)
concepts.titleEs: Optimización de costos de bases de datos (reserved DB instances, serverless, retención)
concepts.summary: Cut DB cost with reserved instances for steady DBs, serverless/on-demand for variable load, right-sized instances and snapshot retention policies.

concepts.title: Loose coupling and decoupling principles
concepts.titleEs: Principios de loose coupling y desacoplamiento
concepts.summary: Insert queues/topics/event buses between components so each can scale and fail independently.

concepts.title: Amazon SQS standard vs FIFO queues
concepts.titleEs: Amazon SQS: colas standard vs FIFO
concepts.summary: Use standard queues for nearly unlimited throughput with at-least-once delivery, FIFO for strict ordering and exactly-once processing.

concepts.title: SQS visibility timeout, dead-letter queues, long polling, delay queues
concepts.titleEs: SQS visibility timeout, dead-letter queues, long polling, delay queues
concepts.summary: Prevent duplicate processing by tuning visibility timeout, isolate poison messages in a DLQ, and cut empty receives with long polling.

concepts.title: Queue-based load leveling and scaling consumers on backlog
concepts.titleEs: Nivelación de carga con colas y escalado de consumidores por backlog
concepts.summary: Buffer bursts with SQS and scale EC2/ECS/Lambda consumers on backlog per instance so no requests are lost under spikes.

concepts.title: Amazon SNS pub/sub and SNS-to-SQS fan-out
concepts.titleEs: Amazon SNS pub/sub y fan-out SNS-a-SQS
concepts.summary: Push one message to many subscribers (SQS, Lambda, HTTP, email/SMS), using fan-out to SQS for durable parallel processing and message filtering.

concepts.title: Amazon EventBridge event bus, rules, scheduler and pipes
concepts.titleEs: Amazon EventBridge: event bus, rules, scheduler y pipes
concepts.summary: Route AWS service, SaaS and custom events with content-based rules to many targets, and replace cron servers with EventBridge Scheduler.

concepts.title: Amazon MQ (ActiveMQ/RabbitMQ)
concepts.titleEs: Amazon MQ (ActiveMQ/RabbitMQ)
concepts.summary: Migrate apps using standard protocols (JMS, AMQP, MQTT, STOMP) to a managed broker without rewriting messaging code.

concepts.title: AWS Step Functions workflow orchestration
concepts.titleEs: AWS Step Functions: orquestación de workflows
concepts.summary: Orchestrate multi-step processes with retries, branching, parallelism, waits and human approval (Standard vs Express workflows).

concepts.title: Amazon API Gateway: REST vs HTTP vs WebSocket APIs
concepts.titleEs: Amazon API Gateway: REST vs HTTP vs WebSocket APIs
concepts.summary: Front Lambda/HTTP/AWS service backends with a managed API, choosing REST (features, private, caching, usage plans), HTTP (cheaper, faster) or WebSocket.

concepts.title: API Gateway throttling, usage plans and caching
concepts.titleEs: API Gateway: throttling, usage plans y caching
concepts.summary: Protect backends and control cost with rate/burst limits, per-client API keys and usage plans, and response caching.

concepts.title: API Gateway authorization: IAM, Cognito, Lambda authorizers, private APIs
concepts.titleEs: Autorización en API Gateway: IAM, Cognito, Lambda authorizers, private APIs
concepts.summary: Secure APIs with Cognito user pool authorizers, IAM SigV4, Lambda authorizers for custom tokens, resource policies, or private endpoints.

concepts.title: Event-driven architecture patterns
concepts.titleEs: Patrones de arquitectura orientada a eventos
concepts.summary: Design producers/consumers that react asynchronously to events (S3 upload -> Lambda -> queue) instead of synchronous chains.

concepts.title: Microservices design on AWS
concepts.titleEs: Diseño de microservicios en AWS
concepts.summary: Split a monolith into independently deployable services with their own data stores, communicating via APIs and events.

concepts.title: Serverless application pattern (API Gateway + Lambda + DynamoDB + S3)
concepts.titleEs: Patrón de aplicación serverless (API Gateway + Lambda + DynamoDB + S3)
concepts.summary: Build a scalable, pay-per-use web backend with no servers when traffic is variable and operational overhead must be minimal.

concepts.title: Multi-tier (web/app/data) architecture design
concepts.titleEs: Diseño de arquitectura multinivel (web/app/datos)
concepts.summary: Assemble ELB + ASG across AZs + managed DB (+ cache) into a scalable, highly available three-tier application.

concepts.title: Amazon AppFlow (SaaS data integration)
concepts.titleEs: Amazon AppFlow (integración de datos SaaS)
concepts.summary: Move data between SaaS apps (Salesforce, SAP, Zendesk) and S3/Redshift without writing integration code.

concepts.title: Data ingestion patterns: batch vs streaming, frequency and size
concepts.titleEs: Patrones de ingesta: batch vs streaming, frecuencia y tamaño
concepts.summary: Choose batch or streaming ingestion from data frequency, latency requirement and volume.

concepts.title: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams (shards, retention, ordering)
concepts.titleEs: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams (shards, retención, orden)
concepts.summary: Ingest real-time streams with multiple consumers, replay (up to 365 days), per-shard ordering, provisioned or on-demand capacity.

concepts.title: Amazon Data Firehose (delivery to S3/Redshift/OpenSearch)
concepts.titleEs: Amazon Data Firehose (entrega a S3/Redshift/OpenSearch)
concepts.summary: Load streaming data into S3/Redshift/OpenSearch/Splunk near real time with no code, buffering, Lambda transforms and Parquet conversion.

concepts.title: Amazon MSK (managed Apache Kafka)
concepts.titleEs: Amazon MSK (Apache Kafka administrado)
concepts.summary: Pick MSK (provisioned or serverless) to migrate existing Kafka workloads or when Kafka APIs/larger messages are required.

concepts.title: Data lake architecture on Amazon S3
concepts.titleEs: Arquitectura de data lake sobre Amazon S3
concepts.summary: Store raw/curated data in S3 zones, catalog it, and query it with multiple engines while separating storage from compute.

concepts.title: AWS Glue ETL, crawlers and Data Catalog
concepts.titleEs: AWS Glue: ETL, crawlers y Data Catalog
concepts.summary: Use serverless Glue to discover schemas (crawlers), maintain a central catalog and run Spark ETL jobs with job bookmarks.

concepts.title: Transforming data formats (CSV/JSON to Parquet/ORC) and partitioning
concepts.titleEs: Transformar formatos de datos (CSV/JSON a Parquet/ORC) y particionado
concepts.summary: Convert row formats to compressed columnar Parquet/ORC and partition data to speed queries and cut scan costs.

concepts.title: Amazon Athena serverless SQL on S3
concepts.titleEs: Amazon Athena: SQL serverless sobre S3
concepts.summary: Run ad-hoc SQL on S3 data (logs, data lakes) pay-per-TB-scanned with no infrastructure, including federated queries.

concepts.title: AWS Lake Formation (data lake permissions and governance)
concepts.titleEs: AWS Lake Formation (permisos y gobierno de data lakes)
concepts.summary: Build and secure a data lake with centralized fine-grained (table/column/row) permissions and cross-account sharing.

concepts.title: Amazon Redshift data warehouse (RA3, Serverless, Spectrum)
concepts.titleEs: Amazon Redshift data warehouse (RA3, Serverless, Spectrum)
concepts.summary: Pick Redshift for columnar OLAP/BI over large structured datasets, Spectrum to query S3 without loading, Serverless for intermittent use.

concepts.title: Amazon EMR (Spark/Hadoop big data processing)
concepts.titleEs: Amazon EMR (procesamiento big data con Spark/Hadoop)
concepts.summary: Use EMR for large-scale Hadoop/Spark/Hive/Presto processing with control over frameworks, using Spot task nodes to cut cost.

concepts.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service (search and log analytics)
concepts.titleEs: Amazon OpenSearch Service (búsqueda y análisis de logs)
concepts.summary: Pick OpenSearch for full-text search, log analytics and dashboards over near-real-time data.

concepts.title: Amazon Quick (formerly QuickSight) BI dashboards
concepts.titleEs: Amazon Quick (antes QuickSight): dashboards de BI
concepts.summary: Implement serverless BI dashboards and visualizations over Athena, Redshift, RDS and S3 data with per-user access.

concepts.title: Securing ingestion access points and data lakes
concepts.titleEs: Asegurar puntos de ingesta y data lakes
concepts.summary: Protect ingestion with IAM-scoped producers, interface endpoints, KMS encryption and bucket policies.

concepts.title: Encryption at rest vs in transit
concepts.titleEs: Cifrado en reposo vs en tránsito
concepts.summary: Identify which layer (storage, network/TLS, client-side) a requirement targets and the AWS mechanism that satisfies it.

concepts.title: AWS KMS key types: AWS owned vs AWS managed vs customer managed
concepts.titleEs: Tipos de claves en AWS KMS: AWS owned vs AWS managed vs customer managed
concepts.summary: Choose customer managed keys when you need control over key policy, rotation, auditing, cross-account use or disabling; AWS managed for zero effort.

concepts.title: KMS envelope encryption and data keys
concepts.titleEs: KMS envelope encryption y data keys
concepts.summary: Explain how services encrypt large data with data keys protected by a KMS key (4 KB direct-encrypt limit, request quotas).

concepts.title: KMS key policies, grants and cross-account key use
concepts.titleEs: KMS key policies, grants y uso cross-account
concepts.summary: Implement access policies for keys so only intended principals/services/accounts can encrypt/decrypt (e.g., sharing encrypted snapshots).

concepts.title: KMS automatic and manual key rotation
concepts.titleEs: Rotación automática y manual de claves KMS
concepts.summary: Meet rotation requirements with automatic rotation of customer managed keys (configurable period) or manual rotation via alias for imported keys.

concepts.title: KMS multi-Region keys
concepts.titleEs: KMS multi-Region keys
concepts.summary: Use multi-Region keys to decrypt data in another Region without re-encryption for DR and global apps.

concepts.title: AWS CloudHSM
concepts.titleEs: AWS CloudHSM
concepts.summary: Pick CloudHSM for single-tenant FIPS 140-3 Level 3 HSMs with exclusive customer key control (or as a KMS custom key store).

concepts.title: AWS Certificate Manager: public/private certs and renewal
concepts.titleEs: AWS Certificate Manager: certificados públicos/privados y renovación
concepts.summary: Provision and auto-renew TLS certs for ELB/CloudFront/API Gateway; monitor imported certs expiring since they do not auto-renew.

concepts.title: AWS Secrets Manager (with rotation)
concepts.titleEs: AWS Secrets Manager (con rotación)
concepts.summary: Store DB credentials/API keys with automatic rotation (native for RDS/Aurora/Redshift) and cross-Region replication.

concepts.title: Systems Manager Parameter Store
concepts.titleEs: Systems Manager Parameter Store
concepts.summary: Store configuration and SecureString values cheaply (free standard tier) when automatic rotation is not required.

concepts.title: AWS Shield Standard vs Shield Advanced
concepts.titleEs: AWS Shield Standard vs Shield Advanced
concepts.summary: Rely on free Shield Standard for L3/L4 DDoS; add Shield Advanced for large targets needing DRT support, cost protection and advanced metrics.

concepts.title: AWS WAF (SQL injection, XSS, rate limiting, geo)
concepts.titleEs: AWS WAF (SQL injection, XSS, rate limiting, geo)
concepts.summary: Attach web ACLs to CloudFront/ALB/API Gateway/AppSync/Cognito to block SQLi/XSS, bad IPs, countries and HTTP floods with rate-based rules.

concepts.title: DDoS-resilient architecture
concepts.titleEs: Arquitectura resiliente a DDoS
concepts.summary: Combine CloudFront, Route 53, ELB, Auto Scaling, WAF and Shield to absorb and filter external attacks.

concepts.title: AWS Firewall Manager
concepts.titleEs: AWS Firewall Manager
concepts.summary: Centrally enforce WAF, Shield Advanced, security group and Network Firewall policies across all accounts in an organization.

concepts.title: Amazon GuardDuty threat detection
concepts.titleEs: Amazon GuardDuty: detección de amenazas
concepts.summary: Detect compromised instances/credentials and malicious activity by analyzing CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs and DNS logs with no agents.

concepts.title: Amazon Inspector vulnerability scanning
concepts.titleEs: Amazon Inspector: escaneo de vulnerabilidades
concepts.summary: Continuously scan EC2, ECR images and Lambda functions for CVEs and unintended network exposure.

concepts.title: Amazon Macie sensitive data discovery
concepts.titleEs: Amazon Macie: descubrimiento de datos sensibles
concepts.summary: Discover and classify PII/sensitive data in S3 and flag public or unencrypted buckets.

concepts.title: Amazon Detective investigation
concepts.titleEs: Amazon Detective: investigación
concepts.summary: Investigate root cause of findings by visualizing linked log data rather than detecting threats.

concepts.title: AWS CloudTrail API auditing
concepts.titleEs: AWS CloudTrail: auditoría de APIs
concepts.summary: Record who did what via API across accounts (organization trail to a locked S3 bucket, log file validation, data events for S3/Lambda).

concepts.title: AWS Config rules and configuration history
concepts.titleEs: AWS Config: rules e historial de configuración
concepts.summary: Track resource configuration over time and evaluate/auto-remediate compliance (e.g., unencrypted volumes, public buckets).

concepts.title: AWS Security Hub
concepts.titleEs: AWS Security Hub
concepts.summary: Aggregate findings from GuardDuty/Inspector/Macie and run best-practice/compliance checks across accounts in one view.

concepts.title: Amazon CloudWatch metrics, alarms and dashboards
concepts.titleEs: Amazon CloudWatch: métricas, alarmas y dashboards
concepts.summary: Monitor metrics (install the agent for memory/disk), trigger alarms to scale, notify or recover instances, and define business KPIs.

concepts.title: CloudWatch Logs, Logs Insights and metric filters
concepts.titleEs: CloudWatch Logs, Logs Insights y metric filters
concepts.summary: Centralize logs with retention settings, query them, create metric filters/alarms, and export/subscribe to S3/Firehose.

concepts.title: AWS X-Ray distributed tracing
concepts.titleEs: AWS X-Ray: tracing distribuido
concepts.summary: Trace requests across microservices/Lambda to find latency bottlenecks and errors (workload visibility).

concepts.title: Compliance requirements, AWS Artifact and data classification
concepts.titleEs: Requisitos de compliance, AWS Artifact y clasificación de datos
concepts.summary: Obtain AWS compliance reports/agreements (e.g., BAA, SOC) and align data classification with controls such as encryption, retention and residency.

concepts.title: Data retention, lifecycle and deletion policies
concepts.titleEs: Políticas de retención, ciclo de vida y eliminación de datos
concepts.summary: Implement retention and deletion rules (lifecycle expiration, backup retention, log retention, Object Lock) that satisfy regulation at minimum cost.

concepts.title: RPO and RTO
concepts.titleEs: RPO y RTO
concepts.summary: Translate business tolerance for data loss (RPO) and downtime (RTO) into a recovery design and cost level.

concepts.title: DR strategy: backup and restore
concepts.titleEs: Estrategia de DR: backup and restore
concepts.summary: Pick backup and restore when RPO/RTO of hours are acceptable and cost must be lowest.

concepts.title: DR strategy: pilot light
concepts.titleEs: Estrategia de DR: pilot light
concepts.summary: Keep core data replicated and infra defined but switched off, provisioning compute on failover for RPO minutes / RTO tens of minutes.

concepts.title: DR strategy: warm standby
concepts.titleEs: Estrategia de DR: warm standby
concepts.summary: Run a scaled-down but functional copy in the DR Region that scales up on failover for RTO in minutes.

concepts.title: DR strategy: multi-site active-active
concepts.titleEs: Estrategia de DR: multi-site active-active
concepts.summary: Serve traffic from multiple Regions simultaneously for near-zero RPO/RTO at the highest cost.

concepts.title: AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (DRS)
concepts.titleEs: AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (DRS)
concepts.summary: Replicate on-prem or cloud servers continuously at block level to low-cost staging for recovery in minutes (RPO seconds).

concepts.title: AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) lift-and-shift
concepts.titleEs: AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) lift-and-shift
concepts.summary: Rehost physical/VMware/Hyper-V/cloud servers to EC2 with continuous replication and minimal cutover downtime.

concepts.title: Multi-AZ high availability design
concepts.titleEs: Diseño de alta disponibilidad Multi-AZ
concepts.summary: Spread every tier across at least two AZs with health-checked failover to survive an AZ outage.

concepts.title: Multi-Region architectures
concepts.titleEs: Arquitecturas multi-Region
concepts.summary: Decide when Region-level resilience or global latency justifies multi-Region replication of data, compute and DNS.

concepts.title: Eliminating single points of failure
concepts.titleEs: Eliminar single points of failure
concepts.summary: Spot the single instance, single NAT, single AZ, single DX or single DB in a design and replace it with a redundant option.

concepts.title: Distributed design patterns: retries with backoff, idempotency, circuit breakers
concepts.titleEs: Patrones distribuidos: reintentos con backoff, idempotencia, circuit breakers
concepts.summary: Make components tolerate partial failure with exponential backoff and jitter, idempotent consumers, timeouts and graceful degradation.

concepts.title: Infrastructure as code with AWS CloudFormation
concepts.titleEs: Infrastructure as code con AWS CloudFormation
concepts.summary: Recreate environments consistently (including DR Regions) with templates and StackSets across accounts/Regions; detect drift.

concepts.title: Immutable infrastructure and blue/green deployments
concepts.titleEs: Infraestructura inmutable y despliegues blue/green
concepts.summary: Replace rather than patch servers (new AMI/launch template) and shift traffic blue/green for safe rollback.

concepts.title: AWS Systems Manager: Patch Manager, Run Command, Automation
concepts.titleEs: AWS Systems Manager: Patch Manager, Run Command, Automation
concepts.summary: Automate patching, configuration and remediation runbooks across fleets to maintain infrastructure integrity.

concepts.title: Service quotas and throttling (including standby environments)
concepts.titleEs: Service quotas y throttling (incluidos entornos standby)
concepts.summary: Raise quotas in the DR Region/account ahead of failover and design around API throttling limits.

concepts.title: Improving reliability of legacy apps without code changes
concepts.titleEs: Mejorar la fiabilidad de apps legacy sin cambiar código
concepts.summary: Wrap non-cloud-native apps with ASG (min=max=1) self-healing, EC2 auto recovery, ELB health checks, shared storage and RDS Proxy when code cannot change.

concepts.title: Identifying metrics from business requirements (SLAs, availability targets)
concepts.titleEs: Identificar métricas a partir de requisitos de negocio (SLAs, objetivos de disponibilidad)
concepts.summary: Translate SLAs into measurable metrics (availability %, latency percentiles, synthetic canaries) that drive alarms and failover.

concepts.title: AI services for language and speech: Comprehend, Translate, Lex, Polly, Transcribe
concepts.titleEs: Servicios de IA de lenguaje y voz: Comprehend, Translate, Lex, Polly, Transcribe
concepts.summary: Pick Comprehend (NLP/PII in text), Translate, Lex (chatbots), Polly (text-to-speech) or Transcribe (speech-to-text) instead of building models.

concepts.title: AI services for vision and documents: Rekognition and Textract
concepts.titleEs: Servicios de IA de visión y documentos: Rekognition y Textract
concepts.summary: Use Rekognition for image/video labels, faces and moderation; Textract to extract text, forms and tables from scanned documents.

concepts.title: Amazon SageMaker AI (custom ML models)
concepts.titleEs: Amazon SageMaker AI (modelos de ML propios)
concepts.summary: Choose SageMaker when you must build, train and host custom ML models rather than use a pre-trained AI service.

concepts.title: Governed provisioning: Service Catalog and License Manager
concepts.titleEs: Aprovisionamiento gobernado: Service Catalog y License Manager
concepts.summary: Let users self-provision only approved products (Service Catalog) and track/enforce software license usage (License Manager).

concepts.title: AWS Health Dashboard and Trusted Advisor checks
concepts.titleEs: AWS Health Dashboard y checks de Trusted Advisor
concepts.summary: Use Trusted Advisor for cost/security/fault-tolerance/quota checks (idle resources, open ports) and AWS Health for events affecting your resources.

concepts.title: AWS Cost Explorer
concepts.titleEs: AWS Cost Explorer
concepts.summary: Visualize and forecast spend, and get RI/Savings Plans purchase and rightsizing recommendations.

concepts.title: AWS Budgets and budget actions
concepts.titleEs: AWS Budgets y budget actions
concepts.summary: Alert (or trigger actions like applying an SCP) when cost, usage or RI/SP coverage crosses thresholds.

concepts.title: AWS Cost and Usage Report / Data Exports
concepts.titleEs: AWS Cost and Usage Report / Data Exports
concepts.summary: Deliver the most granular hourly line-item billing data to S3 for analysis with Athena/Quick.

concepts.title: Cost allocation tags and multi-account billing
concepts.titleEs: Cost allocation tags y facturación multi-cuenta
concepts.summary: Activate user-defined/AWS-generated tags to attribute costs per team/project, and use consolidated billing for chargeback and shared discounts.

concepts.title: Data transfer pricing: inter-AZ, inter-Region, internet egress
concepts.titleEs: Precios de transferencia de datos: entre AZs, entre Regions, salida a internet
concepts.summary: Route traffic to minimize charges: same-AZ and private IP paths, avoid unnecessary cross-Region/NAT traffic, use endpoints/CloudFront for egress.

concepts.title: Reducing NAT gateway charges with VPC endpoints
concepts.titleEs: Reducir costos de NAT gateway con VPC endpoints
concepts.summary: Send S3/DynamoDB traffic through free gateway endpoints instead of paying NAT processing charges.

concepts.title: CDN and edge caching strategy for cost and performance
concepts.titleEs: Estrategia de CDN y edge caching para costo y rendimiento
concepts.summary: Use CloudFront to lower origin load and egress cost, improving cache hit ratio and choosing price classes.

concepts.title: Choosing Direct Connect vs VPN vs internet by cost
concepts.titleEs: Elegir Direct Connect vs VPN vs internet por costo
concepts.summary: Compare port-hour and transfer costs to pick VPN for low/variable volume and DX for high sustained volume.

concepts.title: Reviewing existing workloads for network optimizations
concepts.titleEs: Revisar workloads existentes para optimizar la red
concepts.summary: Analyze flow logs and cost data to consolidate NAT/TGW attachments, co-locate chatty components and remove unnecessary hops.

concepts.title: Storage cost optimization (right-size, gp2->gp3, tiering, delete orphans)
concepts.titleEs: Optimización de costos de almacenamiento (right-size, gp2->gp3, tiering, huérfanos)
concepts.summary: Choose the cheapest storage service/tier that meets performance: migrate gp2 to gp3, tier EFS/S3, archive snapshots, remove unattached volumes.

concepts.title: Selecting backup vs archival solutions
concepts.titleEs: Seleccionar soluciones de backup vs archivado
concepts.summary: Match data protection needs to backup (fast restore, versioned) or archive (long retention, rare access) at lowest cost.

confusableGroups.title: SQS vs SNS vs EventBridge vs Amazon MQ vs Step Functions
discriminators: SQS: "decouple", "buffer", "queue", pull-based consumers, one consumer group per message; FIFO for "ordering"/"exactly-once"
SNS: "fan-out", "notify multiple subscribers", push, email/SMS; SNS + SQS for durable fan-out
EventBridge: "react to AWS service/SaaS events", content-based routing rules, schedules (cron), many targets, schema registry
Amazon MQ: "existing app uses JMS/AMQP/MQTT/STOMP/ActiveMQ/RabbitMQ", migrate without code changes
Step Functions: "orchestrate multi-step workflow", retries/branching/wait/human approval, state tracking

confusableGroups.title: Kinesis Data Streams vs Data Firehose vs MSK vs SQS
discriminators: Kinesis Data Streams: "real-time", multiple consumers reading the same data, replay, custom processing, per-shard ordering
Data Firehose: "load into S3/Redshift/OpenSearch" with no code, near real time (buffered), format conversion to Parquet
MSK: "Apache Kafka", existing Kafka producers/consumers, open-source compatibility
SQS (for contrast): per-message processing and deletion, no replay, no multi-consumer stream semantics

confusableGroups.title: Athena vs Redshift vs EMR vs Glue vs OpenSearch vs Quick
discriminators: Athena: "ad-hoc SQL on S3", serverless, pay per query, "least operational overhead" log analysis
Redshift: data warehouse, complex joins/BI over structured data, frequent heavy queries, Spectrum to query S3
EMR: Hadoop/Spark/Hive/Presto frameworks, custom big data processing, control over cluster, Spot task nodes
Glue: serverless ETL, crawlers/Data Catalog, "convert CSV to Parquet", schema discovery
OpenSearch: full-text search, log analytics with dashboards, near-real-time indexing
Quick (QuickSight): dashboards and visualization for business users

confusableGroups.title: S3 vs EBS vs Instance Store vs EFS vs FSx
discriminators: S3: object storage, unlimited scale, HTTP access, static content, data lakes, lowest cost at scale
EBS: block storage for one instance (Multi-Attach io2 only), same AZ, boot volumes and databases
Instance store: highest IOPS, ephemeral, data lost on stop/terminate, scratch/cache/replicated data
EFS: shared POSIX/NFS for many Linux instances across AZs, elastic, Lambda/containers
FSx for Windows: SMB, NTFS, Active Directory; FSx for Lustre: HPC/ML with S3 link; FSx ONTAP/OpenZFS: NetApp/ZFS lift-and-shift, multi-protocol

confusableGroups.title: ALB vs NLB vs GWLB
discriminators: ALB: HTTP/HTTPS Layer 7, path/host/header routing, microservices/containers, Lambda targets, WAF, OIDC/Cognito auth
NLB: TCP/UDP/TLS Layer 4, static/Elastic IP per AZ, millions of rps, ultra-low latency, PrivateLink service front end
GWLB: deploy/scale third-party virtual appliances (firewalls, IDS/IPS), GENEVE, transparent bump-in-the-wire

confusableGroups.title: CloudFront vs Global Accelerator vs S3 Transfer Acceleration
discriminators: CloudFront: caching HTTP(S) content at the edge, static/dynamic websites, video, OAC for S3, WAF integration
Global Accelerator: static anycast IPs, TCP/UDP non-HTTP, gaming/IoT/VoIP, fast deterministic Regional failover, no caching
S3 Transfer Acceleration: faster long-distance uploads into one S3 bucket

confusableGroups.title: RDS vs Aurora vs DynamoDB vs DocumentDB vs Keyspaces vs Neptune
discriminators: RDS: relational, specific engine/version (Oracle, SQL Server, Db2), lift-and-shift of existing DB
Aurora: MySQL/PostgreSQL-compatible with higher performance, 15 low-lag replicas, Global Database, serverless scaling
DynamoDB: key-value/NoSQL, single-digit-ms at any scale, serverless, unpredictable traffic, session data
DocumentDB: "MongoDB compatible" JSON documents
Keyspaces: "Apache Cassandra"/CQL
Neptune: graph, relationships, social networks, fraud detection, knowledge graphs

confusableGroups.title: RDS Multi-AZ vs read replicas vs Aurora Global Database vs DynamoDB global tables
discriminators: RDS Multi-AZ: high availability, automatic failover, synchronous, same Region, standby not readable (instance deployment)
Read replicas: scale reads/reporting, asynchronous, can be cross-Region, manual promotion for DR
Aurora Global Database: cross-Region relational DR with RPO ~1 s and RTO ~1 min, low-latency global reads
DynamoDB global tables: multi-Region multi-active writes for NoSQL

confusableGroups.title: ElastiCache Redis/Valkey vs Memcached vs DAX
discriminators: Redis/Valkey: replication, Multi-AZ failover, persistence/backup, pub/sub, sorted sets (leaderboards), session store
Memcached: simple cache, multithreaded, horizontal sharding, no persistence or replication
DAX: DynamoDB-only microsecond cache with minimal code changes

confusableGroups.title: Secrets Manager vs SSM Parameter Store
discriminators: Secrets Manager: "automatic rotation" of DB credentials/API keys, cross-Region replication, higher cost per secret
Parameter Store: configuration values and SecureStrings, hierarchical, free standard tier, no built-in rotation

confusableGroups.title: VPC peering vs Transit Gateway vs Site-to-Site VPN vs Direct Connect vs Client VPN
discriminators: VPC peering: few VPCs, non-transitive, lowest cost, no overlapping CIDRs
Transit Gateway: many VPCs/accounts + on-prem, transitive hub, route-table segmentation, ECMP for VPN bandwidth
Site-to-Site VPN: quick setup, encrypted over internet, low cost, backup for DX
Direct Connect: dedicated private line, consistent latency/bandwidth, large transfers, lower egress cost, weeks to provision (not encrypted by default)
Client VPN: individual remote users connecting from laptops

confusableGroups.title: NAT gateway vs gateway endpoint vs interface endpoint vs PrivateLink service
discriminators: NAT gateway: private instances need outbound internet (patches, third-party APIs), no inbound
Gateway endpoint: S3 or DynamoDB only, free, route-table entry, avoids NAT charges
Interface endpoint: other AWS services (or S3 from on-prem), private IP ENI, reachable over VPN/DX, hourly + data cost
PrivateLink endpoint service: expose your own NLB-fronted service to other VPCs/accounts without peering, overlapping CIDRs OK

confusableGroups.title: Security groups vs network ACLs
discriminators: Security group: instance/ENI level, stateful, allow rules only, can reference other SGs
NACL: subnet level, stateless (open ephemeral ports for return traffic), allow and deny, rules evaluated in number order; "block a specific IP"

confusableGroups.title: Storage Gateway: S3 File vs Volume (cached/stored) vs Tape
discriminators: S3 File Gateway: NFS/SMB file shares on-prem backed by S3 objects
Volume Gateway cached: iSCSI, primary data in S3, frequently accessed cached locally
Volume Gateway stored: iSCSI, full dataset on-prem with async point-in-time backups to AWS
Tape Gateway: replace physical tapes, existing backup software, archive to Glacier/Deep Archive

confusableGroups.title: Snow Family vs DataSync vs Transfer Family
discriminators: Snow Family: offline, huge data (tens of TB to PB), limited/slow bandwidth, edge compute in disconnected sites
DataSync: online automated/scheduled migration or sync of NFS/SMB/HDFS/object data to S3/EFS/FSx
Transfer Family: partners must keep using SFTP/FTPS/FTP/AS2 clients into S3/EFS

confusableGroups.title: Shield vs WAF vs Firewall Manager vs Network Firewall vs GuardDuty vs Inspector vs Macie vs Detective vs Security Hub
discriminators: Shield: DDoS (Standard free L3/L4; Advanced for DRT, cost protection)
WAF: Layer 7 SQL injection, XSS, rate limiting, IP/geo blocking on CloudFront/ALB/API Gateway
Firewall Manager: centrally enforce WAF/Shield/SG/Network Firewall rules across an organization
Network Firewall: stateful VPC traffic inspection, IPS, domain allow/deny lists
GuardDuty: intelligent threat detection from CloudTrail/VPC Flow Logs/DNS logs (compromised instance, crypto mining)
Inspector: vulnerability/CVE scanning of EC2, ECR images, Lambda
Macie: discover PII/sensitive data in S3
Detective: investigate root cause of findings
Security Hub: aggregate findings and run compliance standards checks

confusableGroups.title: CloudTrail vs Config vs CloudWatch vs X-Ray vs VPC Flow Logs
discriminators: CloudTrail: "who made the API call", auditing account activity
Config: "resource configuration history/compliance", rules and auto-remediation
CloudWatch: metrics, logs, alarms, dashboards; performance and operational monitoring
X-Ray: trace requests across distributed services, latency bottlenecks
VPC Flow Logs: IP traffic metadata accepted/rejected at ENI/subnet/VPC

confusableGroups.title: Cost Explorer vs Budgets vs CUR vs cost allocation tags vs Compute Optimizer vs Trusted Advisor
discriminators: Cost Explorer: visualize/forecast spend, RI/SP recommendations
Budgets: alerts or automated actions when thresholds are exceeded
Cost and Usage Report: most granular line-item data for custom analysis (Athena)
Cost allocation tags: attribute cost to teams/projects/environments
Compute Optimizer: ML-based right-sizing for EC2/ASG/EBS/Lambda/ECS
Trusted Advisor: best-practice checks (idle resources, open security groups, service quotas); Health Dashboard: AWS events affecting your resources

confusableGroups.title: Reserved Instances vs Savings Plans vs Spot vs Dedicated vs Capacity Reservations
discriminators: Reserved Instances: steady 1-3 year usage of a specific instance config (also RDS/ElastiCache/Redshift)
Savings Plans: steady $/hour commitment with flexibility across families/Regions and Fargate/Lambda (Compute SP)
Spot: interruptible, fault-tolerant, stateless or flexible batch; biggest discount
Dedicated Hosts: BYOL per-socket/core licenses, host affinity; Dedicated Instances: hardware isolation only
Capacity Reservations: guarantee capacity in an AZ with no term commitment

confusableGroups.title: Lambda vs Fargate vs ECS on EC2 vs EKS vs Elastic Beanstalk vs Batch
discriminators: Lambda: event-driven, short (<15 min), spiky traffic, pay per invocation, no servers
Fargate: containers without managing servers, long-running tasks
ECS on EC2: container control (GPU, custom AMI, RI/Spot capacity), AWS-native orchestration
EKS: Kubernetes required, portability, existing K8s tooling
Elastic Beanstalk: deploy a web app quickly with managed platform, developers not infra experts
Batch: queued batch/HPC jobs with managed scheduling

confusableGroups.title: Outposts vs Local Zones vs Wavelength vs VMware Cloud on AWS vs ECS/EKS Anywhere
discriminators: Outposts: AWS infrastructure in your data center, data residency, low latency to on-prem systems
Local Zones: AWS compute close to a metro area, single-digit-ms latency
Wavelength: 5G carrier networks, mobile edge ultra-low latency
