VMware Cloud on AWS: keep vSphere tooling, migrate VMware without re-platforming
ECS/EKS Anywhere: run containers on your own hardware with AWS tooling

confusableGroups.title: Route 53 routing policies
discriminators: Failover: active-passive DR with health checks
Latency-based: route to lowest-latency Region
Geolocation: route by user location (country/continent) for compliance/localization; Geoproximity: by distance with bias
Weighted: percentage split, canary/blue-green testing

confusableGroups.title: S3 bucket policies vs presigned URLs vs Access Points vs CloudFront signed URLs/cookies
discriminators: Bucket policy: bucket-wide rules, cross-account, enforce encryption/TLS/VPC endpoint conditions
Presigned URL: temporary access to one object for a user without AWS credentials
Access Points: many apps/teams sharing a bucket with separate policies, VPC-only access
CloudFront signed URLs/cookies: restrict content served through CloudFront (single file vs many files)

confusableGroups.title: S3 Standard-IA/One Zone-IA vs Intelligent-Tiering vs Glacier classes
discriminators: Standard-IA: infrequent access, ms retrieval, multi-AZ, retrieval fee, 30-day minimum
One Zone-IA: infrequent, re-creatable data, single AZ, cheaper
Intelligent-Tiering: unknown or changing access patterns, no retrieval fees, monitoring fee
Glacier Instant Retrieval: archive accessed ~quarterly with ms access; Flexible Retrieval: minutes-hours; Deep Archive: 12-48 h, cheapest, 7-10 year retention

confusableGroups.title: S3 Versioning vs Object Lock vs Replication
discriminators: Versioning (+MFA Delete): recover from accidental deletes/overwrites
Object Lock/Vault Lock: WORM compliance retention, nobody (even root) can delete in compliance mode
Replication (CRR/SRR): copy to another Region/account for DR, latency, or compliance

confusableGroups.title: AWS Backup vs EBS snapshots/DLM vs RDS automated backups vs DynamoDB PITR
discriminators: AWS Backup: centralized, cross-service, cross-account/cross-Region backup policies and Vault Lock
EBS snapshots + Data Lifecycle Manager: automate EBS snapshot/AMI schedules
RDS automated backups: point-in-time restore within retention (max 35 days); manual snapshots for longer
DynamoDB PITR: restore a table to any second in last 35 days

confusableGroups.title: Application Migration Service vs DMS vs Elastic Disaster Recovery
discriminators: Application Migration Service (MGN): lift-and-shift servers to EC2
DMS (+ schema conversion): migrate databases with minimal downtime; heterogeneous needs schema conversion
Elastic Disaster Recovery: continuous block-level replication for fast server recovery (DR, not migration)

confusableGroups.title: KMS (AWS managed / customer managed / multi-Region) vs CloudHSM
discriminators: AWS managed key: default service encryption, no management, cannot change policy
Customer managed key: own key policy, rotation control, cross-account sharing, audit via CloudTrail
Multi-Region keys: same key material in multiple Regions for DR/global apps
CloudHSM: single-tenant HSM, FIPS 140-3 Level 3, customer has exclusive control of keys

confusableGroups.title: IAM Identity Center vs SAML/OIDC federation vs Directory Service vs Cognito user/identity pools
discriminators: IAM Identity Center: workforce SSO across many AWS accounts and business apps
SAML/OIDC federation to IAM roles: existing corporate IdP, per-account federation
Directory Service: AD Connector (proxy to on-prem AD), Managed Microsoft AD (full AD in AWS, trusts), Simple AD (basic)
Cognito user pools: customer/app user sign-up and sign-in, JWTs, social login
Cognito identity pools: temporary AWS credentials for app users (including guests)

confusableGroups.title: Identity policies vs resource policies vs SCPs vs permissions boundaries
discriminators: Identity-based policy: what a user/group/role can do
Resource-based policy: who can access this resource, including other accounts or services
SCP: maximum permissions for accounts/OUs in an organization, grants nothing, affects root user of member accounts
Permissions boundary: maximum permissions for a specific IAM user/role, delegated administration

confusableGroups.title: Backup & restore vs pilot light vs warm standby vs multi-site active-active
discriminators: Backup & restore: RPO/RTO hours, lowest cost
Pilot light: data replicated live, core services off; RPO/RTO tens of minutes
Warm standby: scaled-down full stack running; RTO minutes
Multi-site active-active: full capacity in multiple Regions; near-zero RPO/RTO, highest cost

confusableGroups.title: Comprehend/Translate/Lex/Polly/Transcribe vs Rekognition/Textract vs SageMaker
discriminators: Comprehend: sentiment, entities, PII in text; Translate: language translation; Lex: chatbots; Polly: text-to-speech; Transcribe: speech-to-text
Rekognition: images/video objects, faces, moderation; Textract: extract text/forms/tables from documents
SageMaker AI: build/train/deploy custom models when no pre-trained service fits
